diagnosis: The educational portal mounts schoolSubApp on '/districts/:districtId/schools', but the report card handler retrieves records solely using req.params.studentId without asserting that the student is enrolled in the specified schoolId or districtId. A school teacher or administrator in one district can view disciplinary records and grades of students enrolled in any other school district.
exploit_request:
GET /districts/district_99/schools/sch_101/students/std_220914/report-card HTTP/1.1
Host: sis.education.internal:5000
Cookie: session_auth=staff_district_99
Accept: application/json
